title: standalone CDA reshape workflows related-source-after-pivot related-source-after-pivot
classification: Partial harness failure at saved-preview response correlation. One native table-open action and the initial two-root source preview completed; the captured POST response returned two rows matching the raw oracle. The workflow then timed out because its waiter required GET /preview with outputId in the query. Pivot and later transitions were not exercised.

failure.message: Timed out waiting for owned CDA request

sourceReferences.fact: openTable waits for a captured GET /preview with query.outputId before reading the saved preview.
the client issues /preview using a JSON request body including receiptId and outputId.

failure.interpretation: This waiter mismatch prevented preview-oracle validation and every later Cancel/Apply/edit/removal/reload check. No service request failed; no product failure or complete user lifecycle is established.
